label: input
description: Read a logical input state (pin 1–16). 1 means active.

label: output
description: Read or write a MOSFET output (pin 1–16). 1 turns the output on, 0 turns it off.

label: var
detail:
var(id:string) => value:number | string
var(id:string, value:number | string) => ok:number
description: Read or write a Modbus variable. Writing updates the value and, for master/local sources, the point.

label: modbus
detail:
modbus(device:string | number, point:string | number) => value:number
modbus(device:string | number, point:string | number, value:number | string) => ok:number
description: Read or write a Modbus profile point directly. Device and point accept an ID or a numeric Modbus address; use the ID when addresses repeat.

label: port_r
detail:
repeat while held on IN1–IN16
$e0=input index:number (0–15)
$e1=value:number

label: modbus
detail:
a Modbus master variable changed
read it with var(id:string)
